Global (All).title: Cyberattack Disrupts US Banks' Online Services
Global (All).summary: A ransomware attack on US banks' online services causes widespread disruptions, raising concerns about the vulnerability of financial systems.

Global (All).title: Protests Erupt in China Over COVID Restrictions
Global (All).summary: Anti-government protests break out in multiple cities across China as people demand an end to the country's strict COVID-19 restrictions.

Global (All).title: Taliban Bans Women From Working for NGOs
Global (All).summary: The Taliban regime in Afghanistan issues a decree banning women from working for non-governmental organizations (NGOs), sparking widespread condemnation from the international community.

United States.title: Supreme Court Declines to Block Abortion Ban in Idaho
United States.summary: The US Supreme Court declined to block an abortion ban in Idaho, setting up a potential showdown over reproductive rights.

United States.title: US Lawmakers Introduce Bill to Regulate Artificial Intelligence
United States.summary: US lawmakers have introduced a bill to regulate the development and use of artificial intelligence, citing concerns over bias and accountability.

United States.title: House Panel Advances Bill to Rein in Big Tech
United States.summary: A House of Representatives panel advanced a bill aimed at reining in the power of big tech companies, following months of antitrust scrutiny.

South Korea.summary: South Korea reports North Korea fired missile towards the Sea of Japan. US, Japan, S. Korea conduct joint drills amid tensions.
S. Korean government imposes stricter COVID-19 measures due to rising Omicron variant cases.

Japan.title: North Korea missile launch
Japan.summary: North Korea test-fired a missile off its eastern coast, sparking concerns in Japan and other regional countries, and leading to heightened alert levels along the Japanese coast.

Japan.title: COVID-19 outbreak in Japan
Japan.summary: Japan has reported an increase in COVID-19 cases due to a new Omicron subvariant, sparking concerns about the possibility of a new wave of infections.

Japan.title: Japan’s defense budget increase
Japan.summary: Japan's defense budget has been increased to address concerns about North Korea's military activities and the country's own defense capabilities, sparking debates about the role of Japan's military.
